competitorWins: Zoom Earth is the better pure weather-map experience: near real-time imagery every 10–15 minutes from NOAA GOES, Himawari and Meteosat, HD twice-daily passes from NASA Aqua/Terra, rain radar with nowcasting, full forecast-model maps (GFS, ICON), best-in-class hurricane tracking from NHC/JTWC/IBTrACS data, wildfire heat spots from NASA FIRMS and GeoColor day/night imagery. If storms are your thing, its focused weather command-center design beats any generalist globe for depth.
description: Zoom Earth is a free interactive weather map and real-time storm tracker: near real-time satellite imagery (updated every 10 minutes from geostationary satellites), rain radar with nowcasting, hurricane and wildfire tracking, and global forecast maps. Extra features sit behind a Zoom Earth Pro subscription. WorldEye is complementary for breadth: a free 3D globe that mixes weather with live flights, ships, 74,229 cameras, earthquakes, wildfires and satellite imagery — the whole planet, not just the storm.
